name: disk-sentinel
description: Quiet free-space sentinel that surfaces in the status line only near or below its threshold, plus a /targets listing of build-cache dirs and whether a live task still owns them.

freeThresholdGb.title: Free space alarm threshold (GB)
freeThresholdGb.description: Toast and notify once when free disk space drops below this many GB; the status line appears within 10 GB of it.
